minutes.headline: Select Board recommended most special town meeting articles, deferred several to next week, and appointed a Parks Commissioner.
minutes.summary: The board held a joint meeting with the Parks Commission to appoint a new member, then discussed the Marshall Park grant article. It went through the draft special town meeting warrant article by article, recommending some and deferring others until next week. It also reviewed town properties, began a bylaw review, and heard strong public comment about the tax investigation team.

public_comment.topic: Said the investigation team should publish questions, open its process, and move faster; criticized the draft report and the open meeting law violation.
Criticized the tax investigation team, urged the chair and town manager to resign or the team be dissolved and restructured.
Urged the community to move on from the tax issue and support town employees; praised the new assessors and Marshall Park.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted to recommend most draft special town meeting articles, including a roof repair, two sewer stabilization transfers and the Marshall Park article.
Six articles (A, B, C, D, N and P) were deferred to next week, ahead of the warrant signing deadline.
The board recommended the primary school cooling systems article (E) on a 3-1 vote, with one member objecting to the choice of system.
At a joint meeting, the Select Board and Parks Commission appointed a new Parks Commissioner through May 2024 by roll call.
Public commenters sharply criticized the tax investigation team, and the board began a bylaw review, voting to replace 'selectman' with 'select board' in chapter 74.

why_it_matters: The articles recommended here, covering school cooling, a roof repair, sewer reserves and ARPA funds, are the ones residents will be asked to vote on at special town meeting, and the Select Board's recommendation will appear beside them.
Six articles still have no recommendation, so what they would ask of taxpayers is undecided until the board returns to them next week.
watch_next: The deferred articles A, B, C, D, N and P are to be revisited next week before the warrant signing deadline.
Board members are to review the remote participation policy (chapter 305) and chapter 5 bylaws for the October 24 meeting.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on nearly every vote, including the 3-1 tally on Article E, and most differences are caption errors in amounts and names. The one substantive vote difference is Article L, which we label Agricultural Commission and the town records as a zoning bylaw definitions amendment. The payroll warrant figures and the Marshall Park follow-up decision also need checking against the video.
